clauses.clause_label: Permission to use, copy, modify, and run
clauses.scope_note: Permission covers the software for the listed purposes when interacting with Code Awareness tools; it is not an unrestricted grant for other purposes.
clauses.condition_explanation: At least one of personal use, research use, or internal organizational use must apply, and the use must involve interaction with Code Awareness tools.

clauses.clause_label: You may: local run, internal modification, and source study
clauses.scope_note: The listed permissions are local running, modification for internal purposes, and study of the source code. The text does not grant a general right to distribute modifications.
clauses.condition_explanation: Permission applies to the listed activity: running locally, modifying for internal purposes, or studying the source code.

clauses.scope_note: Prohibits using the software to build or operate the specified competing systems.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the software is used to build or operate a competing AI memory, intent-tracking, or development governance system.

clauses.scope_note: Prohibits offering the software or its derivatives as a hosted service.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the software or a derivative is offered as a hosted service.

clauses.clause_label: You may NOT: redistribution in commercial product
clauses.scope_note: Prohibits redistributing the software as part of a commercial product unless Code Awareness LLC gives written permission; the text does not specify permission terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies if written permission from Code Awareness LLC has not been obtained.

coverage_notes: The supplied text is a source-available license, not a conventional open-source grant. No general permission to distribute, sublicense, charge for, sell, or provide network access is stated; absence of a grant is not treated as a prohibition beyond the express hosted-service and commercial-product restrictions.
The contribution statement on line 14 does not specify a licensee activity or terms for contributions and is not extracted as an operative ASC clause.

Lines 28–30 state that no patent rights are granted except as necessary to use the software under the license; they do not supply a separate patent grant. The warranty disclaimer is unrelated to the requested activities.
